phone.note: Home (Questions tab). Tap the "✏️ Mind maps" pill under "Your questions".
Science Claw Mind Lab opens. Tap "✏️ Make my own mind map".
"My mind maps" sheet: Chapter picker, "＋ Start a new mind map", tip, and "No mind maps yet..." (nothing saved yet). Tap the Chapter box.
Chapter set to "Heat (P4)". Tap "＋ Start a new mind map".
A new map opens: name "My Heat mind map", "HEAT · P4", "Saved ✓" pill, the chapter name already in the middle. The Middle word box is ready to type in.
Middle word typed: HEAT. It appears in the middle of the map. Tap "＋ Add a branch".
Branch 1 box appears (colour Red picked for you) and a dashed box appears on the map. Type the branch word.
"Saving…" shows for a moment while you type.
Branch 1 typed: "Temperature". "Saved ✓" is back. Tap "＋ Add a sub-branch".
Scrolled up: the map now has HEAT in the middle and a red line to the "Temperature" box.
A Sub-branch 1 box appears under Branch 1, and a small dashed box on the map. Type a detail.
Two sub-branches typed under Temperature. "Saved ✓" at the top. Tap "＋ Add a branch" for the next big idea.
The map: Temperature now has two small boxes for its details.
Branch 2 "Heat flow" (Orange) with its two sub-branches.
Branch 3 "Conductors" got the next colour by itself. Tap a colour dot to change it (here: Blue).
Blue is ticked; the branch box turns blue.
On the map, the Conductors box and its line are blue too.
The finished map: HEAT in the middle, 3 coloured branches, 6 sub-branches. "Saved ✓" means it is kept on this device.
Closed with ×. Later (even after closing the app), tap "✏️ Make my own mind map" again.
"My mind maps (1)" lists the saved map: a small picture, its name, "Heat · 3 branches", "Changed just now", and the buttons Open / Rename / Delete.
Rename: the name turns into a box. Type the new name and press Enter.
Delete asks first: "Delete it for good?" with "Yes, delete" and "No, keep it". Here: No, keep it.
Kept. New name shows. Tap "Open" to go back into the map.
The map is open again, ready to add more. Tap "🖼 Compare with the poster".
The sheet closes and the Mind Lab shows the Heat poster. Check what you missed. Tap "✏️ Back to my mind map".
Back in your own map, just where you left it. Tap "⬇ Save as picture".
The picture is downloaded (My-Heat-map.png) and the pill says "Picture saved ✓". The saved picture is 28_downloaded_picture_phone.png.
